title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PartnershipSpecification
description: A partnership specification contains all the information for the setup of a partnership of a given kind. This includes the list of identified role types for the partnership with the corresponding agreement specifications. (TM Forum TMF668 Partnership Management 4.0, Swagger definition PartnershipSpecification; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PartnershipSpecification:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PartnershipSpecification'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:PartnershipSpecification:<tmfId>. The identifier of the partnership specification

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/href'. The reference url for this partnership specification

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/description'. An explanatory text regarding this partnership specification

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/name'. An identifying name for the partnership specification.

roleSpecification.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/roleSpecification'. The list of roles specifications a engaged party will be able to play for this kind of partnership

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF668_PartnershipType/blob/v4.0.0/TMF668-PartnershipType-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartnershipSpecification/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'PartnershipSpecification' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name

AgreementSpecificationRef.description: AgreementSpecification reference. An AgreementSpecification represents a template of an agreement that can be used when establishing partnerships.

id.description: Unique identifier of a related entity.

description.description: A narrative that explains in detail what the agreement specification is about.

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

PartnershipRoleSpecification.description: A PartnershipRoleSpecification represents a specification of a role defined in the context of a given type of partnership (PartnershipSpecification), such as Buyer, Seller.

description.description: An explanatory text documenting the role specification

name.description: The name of the role specification. This name uniquely identifies the role specification within the partnership

requiresBilling.description: Indicates whether billing operations will be associated to parties playing the role

requiresSettlement.description: Indicates whether settlement operations will be associated to parties playing the role

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name
